redundancy_context.note: C2 is not independent of geography: most of its cross-country variance that the M0* design spans is geography. The diagnostic says nothing about warming.

provenance_limitation: C2 is CRU-reconstructed 1920-1949 baseline hydroclimatic dryness over resolved support, not a predictor built only from information available before 1950.

support_quality_context.pet_limitation: PET has no meaningful station-count field (Harris et al. 2020); its support is not quantified.
support_quality_context.no_exclusion_threshold: no station-count threshold excludes, reweights or adjusts any country; these quantities are reported only
